_held.why: RESOLVED 2026-09-10 - kept for the record, NOT for an applier. The two sofa lines are separated by the book's own line key: 829180 is a loose 1S, 829179 is the four-piece sectional, and only 829179 matches the build read from the drawing. It is a pure REORDER (1A(LHF)+1NA+CNR+1A(RHF) -> 1A(LHF)+CNR+1NA+1A(RHF)), so no code changes and apply-sofa-compartment-corrections - which pairs rows by code - cannot express it.
